name: nginx-multisite
description: Sets up Nginx as a reverse proxy and web server for three SSL-enabled sites, including site roots, static pages, security hardening, fail2ban, firewall, sysctl, and SSH configuration.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis as local caching services, including Redis authentication, logging, PID-directory handling, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub with Python tooling, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user provisioning, environment configuration, and a systemd service.
